Luke emphasizes the unanimity of concern across both groups: locals and visitors alike plead with Paul to avoid the danger awaiting him."

Classical usage opposed ἐντόπιοι to foreigners or distinguished locals from colonizers. Luke shows broad consensus: everyone, whether visitor or ...
